title: Editorial Writing
modules: The Differences Between Print And Broadcast
The Differences Between Print And Broadcast Media
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of putting something into the group or class, to which it belongs."
Classification is a process of putting something into the group or class, to which it belongs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the quality or the state of the editor being precise or exact in terms of name calling and/or data presentation in the news."
Accuracy in copy editing means the quality or the state of the editor being precise or exact in terms of name calling and/or data presentation in the news.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an aberration and must have a strong justification - such as a special occasion (military coup, an independence anniversary, the signing of a bilateral treaty, etc.)."
A long editorial is an aberration and must have a strong justification - such as a special occasion (military coup, an independence anniversary, the signing of a bilateral treaty, etc.).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the revelation from a joint survey conducted by the Industrial Training Fund (ITF) and the Nigerian Employers Consultative Association (NECA) that 30 per cent of those in employment are incompetent."

Equally disturbing is the revelation from a joint survey conducted by the Industrial Training Fund (ITF) and the Nigerian Employers Consultative Association (NECA) that 30 per cent of those in employment are incompetent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the general science of right and wrong."
Ethics are the general science of right and wrong.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the emergence of some leaders who ordinarily should not be admitted into a serious party."
The resultant effect is the emergence of some leaders who ordinarily should not be admitted into a serious party.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a product of good research."
A highly profound editorial is a product of good research.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known for their roles in the formation of public opinion."
The mass media are known for their roles in the formation of public opinion.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a journalistic article or essay which critically and rationally informs, educates and entertains its target audience on socio- political and economic issues of the day."
An editorial is a journalistic article or essay which critically and rationally informs, educates and entertains its target audience on socio- political and economic issues of the day.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a creative journalistic article which informs, explains, analyses, interprets, and exposes issues for the sake of readers."
A feature is a creative journalistic article which informs, explains, analyses, interprets, and exposes issues for the sake of readers.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the conditions or the state of putting the logically integrated, consistent, sequential for better comprehension by the potential readers, viewers and/or listeners."

Coherence in copy editing simply means the conditions or the state of putting the logically integrated, consistent, sequential for better comprehension by the potential readers, viewers and/or listeners.
fib: ______ is a planned and deliberate effort by the communicator to get his point of view patronised or accepted by his target audience.
Persuasion
Persuasion is a planned and deliberate effort by the communicator to get his point of view patronised or accepted by his target audience.
______ refers to state of your copy being free from grammatical intricacy, complexity, embellishments, and unnecessary elegance.
Simplicity in copy editing
Simplicity in copy editing refers to state of your copy being free from grammatical intricacy, complexity, embellishments, and unnecessary elegance.
______ is a task that requires diligence and creativity by a writer.
Editorial writing
Editorial writing is a task that requires diligence and creativity by a writer.
______ is a profound and remarkable statement of policy with public significance which usually appears on editorial pages expressing the newspaper motto.
slogan
A slogan is a profound and remarkable statement of policy with public significance which usually appears on editorial pages expressing the newspaper motto.
______ is a child of necessity for every journalistic write-up.
Editing
Editing is a child of necessity for every journalistic write-up.
______ is the fact that some of them hold offices that can make one equate them with the party.
More embarrassing and depressing
More embarrassing and depressing is the fact that some of them hold offices that can make one equate them with the party.
______ is a professional journalist who writes a journalistic essay or opinion, expressing the corporate position of a newspaper or media establishment on a topical issue in the society.
editorial writer
An editorial writer is a professional journalist who writes a journalistic essay or opinion, expressing the corporate position of a newspaper or media establishment on a topical issue in the society.
______ is the backbone of serious-minded newspapers.
Editorial piece
Editorial piece is the backbone of serious-minded newspapers.
______ is a definite course of action selected from among alternatives to guide and shape present and future actions.
policy
A policy is a definite course of action selected from among alternatives to guide and shape present and future actions.
______ is the place where the editors take sides and express opinion which they do not do in the news column.
editorial page
The editorial page is the place where the editors take sides and express opinion which they do not do in the news column.
